name: backup
description: Nightly encrypted backup of a 5dive-hosted server's agents to a second provider. Only the owner holds the key.

verbs.name: backup
verbs.summary: nightly encrypted backup of this server's agents; restore one onto a fresh server

setup.hint: Installs restic (a pinned, checksum-verified release) and schedules the nightly backup in /etc/cron.d/5dive-backup. Storage is given to the server by 5dive's API, so this only works on a 5dive-hosted server. The first nightly run makes the key on this server and sends the owner the recovery code by Telegram DM; 5dive never sees it. Undo: sudo 5dive backup uninstall
